operations.name: bank.connections
operations.summary: List connected institutions and their WHAB account destinations.

input.description: Bank-management parameters for an explicitly addressed local budget and enabled provider.

output.description: Safe connection/account setup projection, synchronization counters, update-policy status or background registration result. Bank access tokens, encrypted credentials and cursors are excluded.

operations.permissions: Local HTTPS and budget/workspace guards; CLI uses the authenticated local host. Not exposed through remote ledger operations. OS scheduling requires an explicit enable action.
operations.scope: One provider in one personal budget/environment; background wakeups are device/environment-wide and honor every budget’s saved due policy. Currencies cannot be mixed.
errors: Invalid account, date, currency or duplicate destination is rejected atomically.
Unsupported storage, pending native recovery or unavailable provider fails explicitly.
A linked destination cannot be reassigned after an explicit account setup; existing overlapping history is not automatically matched.
operations.retry: Read status after an uncertain save. Do not recreate a bank connection or blindly replay a financial write. Replaying provider transactions uses stable transaction IDs.
operations.availability: WHAB 2.59+ with a typed bank adapter; Plaid 1.6+ and CLI 2.2+ supply these controls. Manual budgeting requires no bank provider.

operations.name: bank.configure
operations.summary: Save explicit account destinations and inclusive history cutoffs.

input.description: Bank-management parameters for an explicitly addressed local budget and enabled provider.

itemId.description: Identifier from the addressed connection or budget.

accounts.description: Explicit account links and history choices. Select at least one; skipped accounts are omitted.

items.description: One explicitly selected bank account and its destination. Omitted accounts do not import.

bankAccountId.description: Identifier from the addressed connection or budget.

accountId.description: Existing same-currency WHAB account ID, or null to create a new account.

since.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD start date, inclusive; explicit null imports all available history.

output.description: Safe connection/account setup projection, synchronization counters, update-policy status or background registration result. Bank access tokens, encrypted credentials and cursors are excluded.

operations.side_effects: Atomically saves links, joins an existing auto-created account when selected, retains transaction IDs/annotations and resets the cursor for idempotent replay. Does not delete old history or start synchronization.
